# Seattle Seahawks

> Official home of the NFL's Seattle Seahawks with news, schedules, rosters, videos, and fan engagement.

seahawks.com serves as the primary digital hub for the Seattle Seahawks organization, featuring comprehensive coverage of the team's 2025 season, player information, community initiatives, and official merchandise. The site emphasizes fan engagement through The 12s community, youth programs, and multimedia content across news, video, audio, and photo galleries.

## Key Topics

- Seattle Seahawks
- NFL
- 2025 Season Schedule
- Player Roster
- Lumen Field
- The 12s Fan Community
- Sam Darnold

- Community Engagement
- Super Bowl LX
- 50th Season Celebration
- John Schneider
- Pacific Northwest
- Seahawks Merchandise

## News & Updates

- [Seahawks Home](https://www.seahawks.com): Official Seahawks homepage with latest news, videos, stats, schedule, and gameday information
- [Seahawks News](https://www.seahawks.com/news): Latest Seahawks headlines, roster transactions, injury updates, and team news
- [Seahawks 50 Seasons](https://50.seahawks.com): Seahawks 50th season celebration with team history and legacy content

## Team Information

- [Seahawks Roster](https://www.seahawks.com/team/players-roster): Official Seahawks player roster with team information and depth chart
- [Seahawks 2025 Schedule](https://www.seahawks.com/schedule): 2025 Seahawks regular season and preseason schedule with opponent information

## Media & Content

- [Seahawks Videos](https://www.seahawks.com/video): Official Seahawks video content including highlights and documentary series
- [Seahawks Audio & Podcasts](https://www.seahawks.com/audio): Official Seahawks podcasts and audio content with team interviews and analysis
- [Seahawks Photos](https://www.seahawks.com/photos): Official Seahawks photo galleries from games and team events

## Fan Engagement & Community

- [The 12s Fan Community](https://www.seahawks.com/fans/the-12s): Information about The 12s fan community and Seahawks fan culture
- [Seahawks Community](https://www.seahawks.com/community): Seahawks community engagement, youth programs, and charitable initiatives
- [Junior 12s Kids Club](https://www.seahawks.com/junior-12s-kids-club): Seahawks youth program with gameday perks and flag football activities
- [Seahawks Contests & Promotions](https://www.seahawks.com/promotions): Seahawks contests, promotions, and fan engagement offers
- [Seahawks International](https://www.seahawks.com/international): Seahawks international fan engagement and global market programs

## Entertainment & Merchandise

- [Official Seahawks Pro Shop](https://proshop.seahawks.com): Official Seahawks merchandise shop with jerseys, apparel, and fan gear
- [Seahawks Rivalries Uniform Collection](https://rivalries.seahawks.com): Seahawks Rivalries uniform collection and merchandise by Nike
- [Seahawks Dancers](https://www.seahawks.com/dancers): Seahawks Dancers roster, auditions, appearances, and entertainment news
- [Blue Thunder Drumline](https://www.seahawks.com/drumline/blue-thunder): Blue Thunder drumline auditions, appearances, and entertainment information
- [Seahawks Blitz Mascot](https://www.seahawks.com/mascots/blitz): Seahawks mascot Blitz news, appearances, and community events

## Organization & Initiatives

- [Seahawks Mobile App](https://www.seahawks.com/app): Official Seahawks mobile app for iOS and Android with gameday features
- [Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion](https://www.seahawks.com/dei): Seahawks DEI initiatives, employee programs, and community partnerships
